name: Tapo C210 (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only per the maker's spec pages we saw in search snippets; no Ethernet port.

matter.note: None of the Tapo pages we found mention Matter for this camera, and we found no CSA listing.

apple_home.note: No Tapo page we found lists Apple Home or HomeKit for the C210. Only a review and retailer listings mention it.

google_home.note: Link the Tapo account to Google; say 'show me [camera]' to stream to a Nest Hub or Chromecast display. Cloud-to-cloud, stops after 10 minutes. Tapo says live view in the Google Home app is not supported.

alexa.note: Enable the Tapo skill; 'Alexa, show me [camera]' works on Echo Show, Echo Spot and Fire TV. Cloud-to-cloud, stops after 10 minutes. Camera on/off commands are not supported.

smartthings.note: Only marketplace listings claim SmartThings; no Tapo or Samsung page confirms it.

home_assistant.note: Tapo documents RTSP and ONVIF Profile S for wired cameras, which generic ONVIF clients can use. We did not see a Home Assistant page covering this camera.

hubRequired.note: Alexa setup runs through the Tapo app and skill with no hub or bridge.

localControl.note: RTSP and ONVIF streams are available on the local network, but Tapo does not state that app control works without the cloud.

cameraType.note: Sold as a pan/tilt home security camera; the indoor-only wording was not seen on the page snippet.

power.note: Retailer listings give a 9 V DC adapter; no maker page we could open states the power input.

localStorage.note: One microSD slot, up to 512 GB.

subscription.note: Cloud video history needs a Tapo Care plan; microSD recording and RTSP/ONVIF do not. Plan details seen are US pages; EU pricing not confirmed.

summary: The Tapo C210 is a pan/tilt Wi-Fi camera with 3 MP (2304 x 1296) video, 30 ft of infrared night vision and a microSD slot for up to 512 GB. It works with Alexa and Google through Tapo's cloud link, and wired Tapo cameras expose RTSP and ONVIF streams. Cloud history is a separate Tapo Care plan. Apple Home and SmartThings support are not confirmed.
caveats: Alexa and Google streams are cloud-to-cloud and stop after 10 minutes; you ask again to keep watching.
Tapo says live view in the Google Home app is not supported; streaming works on Nest displays and Chromecast.
Tapo Care cloud storage cannot run together with an NVR and a microSD card on some models.
